notes.title: The second episode is here!
notes.content:
All fiery New Year's greetings. Just 3 months later, we are glad to present you the SECOND episode of the visual novel StopGate. Continuation of the legendary story and all that.

You will meet with your favorite characters, as well as the appearance of new ones.

New extraordinary mechanics and select krinzhateka await you.

Well, we don't forget about the favor. The library with your fanfiction (remember there was such a competition?) Is ready to accept its readers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38502856/376dac52b916edcf1614817df068eea09bf2754c.png[/img]

And on top of that, the soundtrack of the second episode also appeared on Steam and you can purchase it if you have a desire to support the project. Although you can find it absolutely free on social networks (shh! I didn't say that)

Well, for those who are interested in how we did it. There is a great movie about creating a project, you can watch it here:

[previewyoutube=3vZSKLzcngI;full][/previewyoutube]
I don’t dare to delay this any longer because the game is waiting for you in just a couple of clicks.

notes.title: Questionnaire
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38502856/129275f1fcd9e4640b28262967adc61cf007cf46.png[/img]

Hello everyone who came to this page. I would like to ask you to take a couple of minutes and go through a short questionnaire. I would like to make a portrait of a player who has become familiar with our game.

This can be done using a google form. No registration required. Everything is anonymously easy and simple:

https://forms.gle/HfB8PWHxBeMqAbnT6

notes.title: Day 5 patch
notes.content:
Hello!
We are glad that our game was warmly welcomed. Thank you all for your feedback, we read them carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38502856/4b3321e8995ad601c3b3f810d632b203e59f464b.png[/img]

In reviews, there are often requests for new features. We hasten to disappoint you: the ability to save anywhere in StopGate, most likely, will not appear (as well as sound settings - there is a volume mixer in Windows, use it), there will be no return to the previous remarks, and we will add the dialog log sometime later ...
Specifically, patch 1.0.2 is not very big:
[list]
[*] We have changed the appearance of the choice slabs in the selection menu. They are thicker now.
[*] The bar was completed a bit.
[*] Fixed several typos in the text.
[*] Changed fonts in the main menu, pause menu and character creation screen.
[*] We also wanted to add the ability to hide the text so that you could admire the backgrounds without interference, but this feature turned out to be not the easiest, so we scored.
[/list]

notes.title: STOPGATE, release
notes.content:
So, StopGate is about to be released (though still the first episode). And I would like to actively leave you feedback. This will help gather opinions and make the second episode better.

You can do this as in the reviews of Steam itself. So on the StopGame.ru website in a special topic for this:
https://stopgame.ru/blogs/topic/104615

Thanks for your attention.
